hypotheses.H0_layer0_has_a_fixed_transport_module: The frozen global top-three heads recover at least 0.75 attention fidelity at Layer 0 on both corpora.
hypotheses.H1_layer1_has_a_fixed_transport_module: The frozen global top-three heads recover at least 0.60 attention fidelity at Layer 1 on both corpora.
hypotheses.H2_family_specific_heads_improve_global: Frozen family-specific top-three heads exceed the global top-three by at least 0.05 in every cell.
hypotheses.H3_calibrated_heads_beat_static_capacity: Frozen global heads exceed state-free tensor-capacity heads by at least 0.30 in every cell.
hypotheses.H4_frozen_heads_transfer_ood: TinyStories frozen-global fidelity is at least 80% of FineWeb fidelity at each layer.
hypotheses.H5_discovery_head_sets_are_stable: Top-three global head sets from the two discovery contexts have Jaccard at least 0.50 at each layer.
hypotheses.H6_family_head_sets_are_distinct: Same-family top-three overlap across discovery contexts exceeds different-family overlap by at least 0.15 at each layer.
